title: feat: add Advanced Arena rankings and tournament workflows
body:
## P4 — Advanced Arena

Stacked on PR #19 (`completion/model-library`); PRs #17 and #18 remain draft checkpoints.

- adds bounded category rankings for quality, latency, throughput, and human scores with explicit direction, ties, uncertainty, and insufficient-data states
- adds baseline/candidate regression comparisons with sample counts and improved/regressed/tie outcomes
- adds a reachable Advanced Arena desktop surface for saved immutable summaries, transparent 1v1, blind ranking, round-robin, and single-elimination scheduling with byes
- adds optional caller-supplied offline AI-judge scores, provenance/network-off labeling, calibration metrics, and disagreement handling
- preserves Core Arena and keeps manual advanced inputs local to the view; no network calls or secrets
- validates with 70 TypeScript tests, 90 Rust tests, typecheck, Vite build, cargo fmt/check, and diff checks via canonical BL4 app_server

P4 remains IN PROGRESS pending native Tauri/WebView QA, local runtime interaction smoke, and remote CI.

No merge, tag, release, deploy, or public release is included.
